quiz.question: If a startup company incurs a heavy financial loss in a particular financial year, is it still legally required to file an income tax return?
options: No, companies only need to file if they make a taxable profit.
Yes, all companies must file regardless of profit or loss.
Only if their income before deductions exceeds the basic exemption limit.
No, unless they also hold foreign assets.
quiz.explanation: Under the Income Tax Act 1961, all companies must file an income tax return regardless of whether they make a profit or a loss. This requirement also applies to partnership firms, LLPs, and trusts, distinguishing them from individuals and HUFs who are bound by exemption limits.
